name: BlackRock
summary: Shows low volatility but faces challenges with rich valuation.

meanings.ret1y: Modest 1-year performance, roughly in line with the market.
meanings.fromHigh: Modest pullback from recent highs, typical consolidation.
meanings.rsi14: Neutral RSI reading, no extreme buying or selling pressure.
meanings.aboveMAs: Above 2 of 3 averages — mostly bullish structure.
meanings.macd: MACD negative and falling — bearish momentum.
meanings.vol: Moderate volatility, roughly in line with the market.
meanings.beta: Above-market beta — tends to move more than the overall market.
meanings.mdd1y: Moderate 1-year drawdown — typical for most stocks.
meanings.sharpe: Poor risk-adjusted return — losses or gains don't justify the volatility.
meanings.pe: Moderate P/E ratio — fairly valued relative to current earnings.
meanings.peVsSector: Above the sector median — more expensive than typical peers.
meanings.revGrowth: Strong revenue growth, expanding the top line.
meanings.margin: Strong profit margin, well above most industries.
meanings.roe: Adequate return on equity, meeting baseline expectations.
meanings.de: Minimal debt — very strong financial position.
meanings.liquidity: Highly liquid — ample trading volume and depth.
